sources.name: Goalie start observations
reasons: Unknown means no current observation, not that the goalie is not starting. Observations cover part of the slate.

evidence.sample: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08: 102 upcoming team games; rates are season to date through 2026-10-31. Unknown means no current observation, not that the goalie is not starting. Observations cover part of the slate. No admitted Start Chart start participation is available, so every forecast is unavailable. A raw start_probability is not admitted. Rates are season to date and #1 is the highest value. Quality, quantity and win are separate, correlated lenses, never added, and no win odds are given. Status: Confirmed and Projected are what a source reported, Conflicting means conflicting reports, and Unknown means no report, which does not mean not starting. A conditional, uncalibrated Start Chart forecast prints as Cond. forecast only when one qualifies; otherwise the forecast is unavailable.
evidence.strength: All situations (shots, xG, chances); PP and PK as labeled
evidence.cohort: 72 goalies with an appearance in their team's last 10 games, on teams scheduled in the window
